mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 60 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

There are no new emails to report, but the police department has released their weekly summary. Notable calls included several vehicle crashes, including one involving an e-moto and a traffic citation for inattentive driving.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, visit the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab pizza at the Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can check out ART House 360 or Hop Haus trivia tomorrow.

In the police weekly report, on October 7, officers responded to a collision at Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive where a juvenile operating an electric motorcycle attempted to pass a turning vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving this delicious treat until 10:00 PM.
